problem_or_genesis_goal: A render exception unmounts the whole studio because the React tree has no error boundary.
reproduction_evidence: src/main.tsx renders App directly. Red-team check 40 is FAIL.
user_impact: One broken screen wipes the shell instead of showing the error and keeping the rest of the session.
indivisibility_proof: The boundary component and the place it wraps are the same behavior.
non_goals: Do not catch main-process exceptions here
metamorphic_invariants: A child that renders normally still shows the studio
A thrown render shows the error text and does not replace it with a blank document
